narrative.overview: HC-HR is where a humanitarian organisation keeps its promises to its own staff: contracts, pay, leave, and hiring across six Syrian cities. The interface should feel like a capable colleague who never raises their voice. Its care shows in restraint: a calm grey canvas, white paper surfaces, a single warm red that appears only where someone has to act, and type that sits comfortably in both English and Arabic.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, strictly rationed; everything else is a warm-leaning neutral ramp.
14px base, major-third type scale, SomarSans for both scripts.
Three radii chosen by element role, never by taste.
Flat-by-default, with shadows tinted from the brand's own dark ink.
Logical properties throughout (ms-, pe-, start/end) so EN/AR mirror for free.

rules.name: The Rationed Red Rule
rules.body: Hope Red covers at most 10% of any screen and appears only on: a primary CTA, the active nav item, a focus ring, a destructive confirm, or a required-field star. Never as a page background or decorative fill.

rules.name: The No-Pink Rule
rules.body: Never tint Hope Red down with opacity for a selected or soft state. A translucent #c2151c reads as pink, which is banned. Use Selection Grey instead.

rules.name: The Status Hue Rule
rules.body: Status colours (success, warning, info) are not yet brand-owned. Where they exist, such as recruitment pills, each hue carries exactly one meaning across the domain and comes from the enum's classes(). Don't invent new ones ad hoc.

rules.name: The Fourteen Rule
rules.body: 14px is the product's base, not 16px. Any size outside the seven steps above is a defect.

rules.name: The Logical Direction Rule
rules.body: Use only start/end logical utilities (ms-, pe-, text-start, ltr:/rtl: variants). A hard-coded left or right is an Arabic bug waiting to happen.

rules.name: The Three Heights Rule
rules.body: There are exactly three elevations. If something seems to need a fourth, it needs a different surface tone instead.

dos: Do use the role radii (rounded-inset, rounded-control, rounded-surface) instead of Tailwind's size radii.
Do use the shared x-primary-button, x-secondary-button and x-recruitment.pill components rather than restyling ad hoc.
Do use the seven text tokens (text-h1 … text-caption) and the e1–e3 shadows only.
Do mark required fields with the required prop on x-forms.input-label.
Do check every screen in /ar before calling it done.
donts: Don't use Hope Red outside its five permitted roles, or at reduced opacity.
Don't use pure-black shadows or introduce a fourth elevation.
Don't hard-code left/right, ml-/mr-, or text-left.
Don't add new status hues without deciding their single meaning first.
Don't fall back to 16px body text or use extrabold/black weights for emphasis.
